verdicts.reason: A keeps the eyebrow and headline together at the top, but the body copy is stranded far left at mid-height, the peach circle is left alone in the top-right corner, separated from the can it used to frame, and the legal line is unreadably small. B keeps the can on its circle, but its layout is scattered across three columns: '20% off' sits below its own supporting copy, the eyebrow floats far above the headline, and the CTA sits in a different column from the headline, so the reading order is jumbled. B's legal text is also too small to read.
